== Summary ==
Slip “•••Porg” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 211, 581, 934)). Version [[Porg]] (Original). Not a recreation.
